findings.title: Renamed function without updating call sites
findings.body: The function was renamed from `readSensor` to `sampleSensor`, but the new name does not match the local convention of using `read` for sensor accessors (e.g., `readSensor`). The rename introduces inconsistency with the rest of the codebase.

summary.problem: The function rename breaks local naming conventions and introduces inconsistency.
summary.done_well: The implementation remains correct and the signature is unchanged.
